code: const MARKET_DECIMALS={NASDAQ:2,GOLD:2,BTC:2,ETH:2};export const getMarketDecimals=market=>{return MARKET_DECIMALS[market]||2;};export const formatPrice=function(price){let market=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:null;if(!price||isNaN(price))return 0;const decimals=market?getMarketDecimals(market):2;return parseFloat(Number(price).toFixed(decimals));};export const formatPnL=function(pnl){let decimals=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:2;if(!pnl||isNaN(pnl))return 0;return parseFloat(Number(pnl).toFixed(decimals));};export const formatPercentage=function(percentage){let decimals=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:2;if(!percentage||isNaN(percentage))return 0;return parseFloat(Number(percentage).toFixed(decimals));};export const displayPrice=function(price){let market=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:null;const decimals=market?getMarketDecimals(market):2;const formatted=formatPrice(price,market);return formatted.toFixed(decimals);};export const displayPnL=function(pnl){let decimals=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:2;const formatted=formatPnL(pnl,decimals);const sign=formatted>=0?'+':'';return"".concat(sign,"$").concat(formatted.toFixed(decimals));};export const displayPercentage=function(percentage){let decimals=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:2;const formatted=formatPercentage(percentage,decimals);const sign=formatted>=0?'+':'';return"".concat(sign).concat(formatted.toFixed(decimals),"%");};
